text:
Alyssa: Quick sync — we need a tiny ops plan for the launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar CTA routing. Main asks: sitemap entries, JSON-LD for article + event, redirects for old campaign URLs, and how inbound leads get tagged. Can dev/SEO/content triage? :calendar:
Miguel: On it. Which exact URLs are in scope? legacy blog slugs or just new launch pages?
Emma: New launch pages (launch blog, benchmark longread, webinar landing, speakers pages, product quickstart). But we also have ~8 legacy slugs we should redirect (old campaign microsites).
Sam: Ok I can do redirects but need a canonical list. For quick wins I can add Netlify redirects rules. Example:
```
# _redirects (Netlify)
/old-launch-2023    /launch-2026  301!
/blog/benchmark-old /benchmark/2026 301
```
I'll push once we confirm list.
Miguel: For sitemap, include paginated benchmark sections? We should include only the canonical paginated-1 URLs and add rel=prev/next on subsequent pages. Also ensure priority: launch blog 0.7, benchmark 0.6, webinar 0.8.
Emma: Agreed. Also need JSON-LD: Article for the launch post + Event for the webinar. Quick JSON-LD scaffold for the webinar (we'll fill specifics):
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Launch & Benchmark Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-05-18T16:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"},
  "organizer": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}
}
</script>
```
We also want Article markup on the benchmark narrative with mainEntityOfPage + author.
Alyssa: Nice. On inbound lead routing: HubSpot form on webinar page should set hidden fields utm_campaign=launch_may2026 and campaign_source=organic. Leads should flow into HubSpot list "Launch_May2026" and Zapier route to SFDC queue "Marketing_Webinar" for MQLs. Miguel can we standardize UTM naming?
Miguel: Standardizing to: utm_source=organic|paid, utm_medium=cta|email, utm_campaign=launch_may2026. We'll add a short doc in GH: marketing/utm-guides/launch-may-2026.md.
Sam: Dev note — for the webinar landing we should pre-render OG tags and include structured data in the server-side render to help social previews and indexing. Also will add canonical tags for any query params (utm_*).
SEO Bot: Reminder: add <link rel="canonical"> to all paginated articles and mark noindex on internal tag archive pages that duplicate content.
Emma: Internal linking plan: from benchmark -> features page, quickstart, speakers bios, and the webinar CTA anchored at top + mid-article. Use anchor text variations: "benchmark results", "how it performs", "register for demo".
Alyssa: Owners and next steps: Emma = content (deliver JSON-LD + canonical list) by EOD tomorrow; Miguel = UTM doc + sitemap priority list; Sam = redirect rules + server-side OG + canonical handling. I'll validate HubSpot flow with CS. Everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you ack.
Miguel: ✅ will do.
Emma: ✅ compiling JSON-LD and canonical list now.
Sam: ✅ prepping redirect patch — will open PR and @mention everyone.
Alyssa: Thanks — once PR merges I'll drop the final QA checklist and schedule a quick 15m runway call the day before. :rocket:
